subject: English
passage:
The following text is adapted from Willa Cather's 1913 novel O Pioneers!

During a winter journey last year, across several townships of Nebraska farmland, I discovered myself, as evening approached, quite uncertain about the route I was following. The terrain stretched endlessly in all directions; and my course, for the past two hours, had twisted and turned so unpredictably, in response to farm boundaries and creek crossings, that I could no longer determine in which direction lay the railroad town of Hanover, where I had planned to spend the night.
prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: The narrator describes pleasant recollections of a trip through the scenic Nebraska countryside.
choices.B: The narrator relates what he observed during an extended journey through a region he knows well.
choices.C: The narrator recounts a journey he took and acknowledges becoming lost.
choices.D: The narrator details the challenges he faced on a trip and describes how he resolved them.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The narrator is 'uncertain' about his route, which leaves him lost and unable to determine how to reach his intended destination.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. This choice doesn't match the passage. The narrator doesn't describe resolving his confusion about directions in this excerpt.
